title: BotDeskLease
description: bot.desk-lease@1 (the Desks plan's D6): one desk OpenVibe.Bot holds for one OpenVibe.Run session, as POST /api/v1/machines/{id}/desk-leases answers it (201, capability bot.desk.session, a Run service token acting for the session's person in X-OV-Subject) and GET /api/v1/machines/{id}/desk-leases/{desk} reads it. The request is bot.desk-lease-create-request@1. Bot leases a desk only on the person's own machine where they turned on 'Let my agent use this computer' (shared false), or on a desk host whose owner offers its desks to other people and whose OpenVibe.Node runs each desk in its own sandbox (describe desk.isolation sandbox; shared true). The lease starts the desk (bot.command@1 kind desk, start, kind browser, the lease's size) and from then on only the lease's person, through Run, may act on that desk, with screen, input and browser at POST /api/v1/machines/{id}/desk-leases/{desk}/commands (bot.command@1 without desk, answered by bot.command-result@1): never another desk, never the machine's own screen, files, programs or network, and on a shared host not even its owner's own commands reach a leased desk. DELETE /api/v1/machines/{id}/desk-leases/{desk} stops the desk and ends the lease; so does the machine going away (Run sees the lease gone, 404, and ends the session host_lost).

owner.description: The session's person, the only one whose commands reach the desk.

shared.description: true on a desk host that serves other people (the desk runs in its own sandbox there); false on the person's own machine.
